statsVisibility.label: Show team stats publicly
statsVisibility.description: Your team stats are private by default. Turn this on to let others see them.
statsVisibility.saveFailed: Failed to update team stats visibility.
letterAvatars.label: Team letter avatars
letterAvatars.description: The Free Fire letter avatars your team can field. Each member's own letter avatars are added automatically. Add any extra letters your team owns below.
letterAvatars.fieldedNote: Only the players you field for an event count toward that event's letter requirement. Benched or staff members do not.
letterAvatars.lockedHint: Already covered by a team member
letterAvatars.saveFailed: Could not update the team letters.
rolePermissions.pageDescription: Choose what each role in {team} is allowed to do.
rolePermissions.explainer: Turn a control on to let everyone with that role use it. Changes apply straight away, and every action is checked again on the server, so a role can only do what you allow here.
rolePermissions.ownerNote: You are the team owner. You always keep every control, whatever you set below, and only you can change these settings.
rolePermissions.readOnlyNote: Only the team owner can change these settings. This is what your team allows right now.
rolePermissions.resetDone: Role permissions reset to the AFC defaults.
rolePermissions.saveFailed: Could not update the role permissions.
rolePermissions.loadFailed: Could not load the role permissions.
rolePermissions.capability.can_invite_me: Send an invite to a player and create join links for the team.
rolePermissions.capability.can_manage_jo: See who asked to join the team and approve or deny them.
rolePermissions.capability.can_edit_rost: Change what role each member holds and their in-game position.
rolePermissions.capability.can_register_: Enter the team into tournaments and scrims, and answer event invitations.
rolePermissions.capability.can_edit_team: Change the team name, tag, logo, description, join settings and social links.
